jobDescription: We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala/PySpark, SQL, and modern data engineering technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, including batch and real-time streaming solutions. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, production support experience, and the capability to independently deliver complex data engineering solutions while mentoring junior team members. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and high-performance data pipelines for batch and real-time data processing. Implement and optimize Kafka-based event streaming solutions. Develop production-grade data processing applications using Apache Spark and Scala/PySpark. Optimize Spark workloads through partitioning, caching, skew handling, join optimization, and performance tuning. Write advanced SQL queries involving complex joins, window functions, data transformations, and query optimization. Design, develop, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT workflows using Apache NiFi, Apache Airflow, or Azure Data Factory (ADF). Work with cloud-based data storage solutions such as Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and Data Lakes. Develop Python scripts, automation utilities, reusable ETL components, and testing frameworks. Monitor and support production data pipelines, troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures. Required Technical Skills: 1. Apache Kafka / Event Streaming - Strong understanding of Kafka architecture, producers, consumers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, offset management, fault tolerance, message delivery guarantees. 2. Apache Spark - Strong hands-on experience with Spark for large-scale data processing, performance tuning, partitioning, caching, data skew handling. 3. Scala / PySpark - Strong proficiency in at least one of Scala or PySpark. 4. SQL - Advanced SQL skills including complex joins, window functions, query optimization, data modeling. 5. Data Orchestration - NiFi / Airflow / ADF. 6. Cloud Storage - S3 / ADLS / Data Lake. 7. Python - Good scripting and automation skills. 8. Production Support and Troubleshooting - Experience handling production incidents, monitoring data pipelines, performing root cause analysis.
